summary: Kraft Heinz Foods Co issued €1B in senior notes (3.500% 2031 & 3.950% 2034) under an effective shelf registration via prospectus supplement. The offering funds a concurrent tender offer for its 4.375% 2046 & 4.875% 2049 notes, with excess proceeds for general corporate/debt repayment. The notes are guaranteed by Kraft Heinz Co and issued under a supplemental indenture with Deutsche Bank Trustee. The board/recommendation not stated; no advisor named. Mechanics involve a liability management exercise to reduce high-coupon debt. Watch tender acceptance rates and interest savings; risk-arb angle centers on spread between new issue costs and retired debt yield.
